name: labiomics
description: LaBiOmicS / UMC plugins for research: academic peer review, congress abstract evaluation and WHOQOL quality-of-life analysis.

plugins.name: academic-peer-review
plugins.description: Multi-reviewer academic peer review panel with statistical, citation, journal-scope and FAIR audits, and PDF report synthesis.

plugins.name: congress-abstract-review
plugins.description: Evaluation of congress abstracts and expanded abstracts: edital compliance, promised-results detection, evaluator panel, barema scoring and committee spreadsheet.

plugins.name: whoqol-toolkit
plugins.description: WHOQOL scoring, psychometrics and publication-grade statistics.
